children.description:
To provision the TimeDB database for downsampling and get connection and retention information, you can use the 'provision_for_timedb' API. 

First, call the 'provision_for_timedb' function without any parameters. This will return the connection and retention information for your account.

Next, to retrieve the list of existing webhooks, call the 'webhooks_for_timedb' function. This will provide you with the list of webhooks associated with your TimeDB account. In this case, the response shows that there are no existing webhooks.

Remember to call the 'Finish' function at the end to provide the final answer.
